Changelog

2026-09-01 — Batch endpoint

The batch endpoint is generally available in all regions.

  • Up to 10,000 requests per batch.
  • 24 hour completion window.

2026-08-18 — Streaming fixes

Fixed a bug where a stream could end without a terminal event.

2026-08-02 — Deprecation

The v1 completions endpoint is deprecated and will be removed in 2027.
